column3: “the records of the generations” renders “the toledot.”
“a varicolored tunic” renders “a tunic of passim,” a word of uncertain meaning (perhaps “long-sleeved”).
“kept the saying in mind” renders “kept the word.”
“aromatic gum and balm and myrrh” render uncertain plant products.
“Midianite traders” and “Ishmaelites” both appear, as in the Hebrew.
